main_body: A sci-fi wall face (steel-blue panels with an orange stripe near the top, inset panel windows, a vent grille, rails and a dark base), drawn flat as a front-facing wall surface
top_band: none; the top is a flat orange stripe (rows 5-6) and a blue-grey band over the header, both vertical wall details, not a horizontal surface seen from above
evidence: The kind is terrain (a wall face tile block), so a flat front view is expected, but it is still a front elevation: no top surface band is visible from above. The panels have inset dark edges and rivets, and the shelf-like orange bars are painted as flat faces. Judged strictly against the contract it reads as a front elevation with no top surface, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has a tinted dark blue outline and some rivet and bolt details, panel inset shading and a few highlight dashes. Its main panels are large flat fills of one blue (about 7x9 px) without grain or speckle, unlike the textured timber and stone references with per-stone shading and plaster speckle. It has about 4 lightness steps against roughly 6 for the references, and its tile density is lower, with many tiles holding only 2-4 colours. A careful artist would find it flatter than the references, so it fails.
